dji - flip drone fly more combo with rc.description: Take your aerial photography to new heights with the DJI Flip Drone Fly More Combo, featuring the advanced RC 2 Remote Controller. This compact and innovative drone is designed for both beginners and seasoned photographers, offering a seamless blend of portability, safety, and cutting-edge technology.Compact and Portable DesignWeighing less than 249 grams, the DJI Flip is as light as an apple and fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. Its foldable design makes it an ideal travel companion, allowing you to capture stunning visuals wherever your adventures take you. With no training or examination required in most regions, you can enjoy the freedom of flight with ease.Advanced Safety FeaturesFly with confidence thanks to DJI's first foldable full-coverage propeller guard. Constructed with a carbon fiber support structure, this guard is incredibly lightweight only 1/60 the weight of traditional materials yet maintains exceptional stiffness for optimal protection. This ensures that even novice pilots can navigate the skies safely.Exceptional Imaging CapabilitiesCapture breathtaking 48MP photos with the DJI Flip's powerful camera, equipped with a 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor, Dual Native ISO Fusion, and a bright f/1.7 aperture. The camera's 2.4-¼m 4-in-1 pixels deliver high dynamic range, preserving intricate details in both highlights and shadows. With up to 4x zoom, you can bring distant subjects into sharp focus.Stunning Video QualityRecord in stunning 4K/60fps HDR to capture every nuance of your surroundings, from vibrant sunsets to dynamic action shots. The DJI Flip also supports slow-motion recording at 4K resolution and 100fps, perfect for highlighting sports and fast-paced activities. Additionally, the 2.7K vertical shooting mode is optimized for social media sharing, eliminating the need for post-capture cropping.Intelligent Shooting ModesUnleash your creativity with six intelligent shooting modes: Dronie, Circle, Rocket, Spotlight, Helix, and Boomerang. These modes provide dynamic angles and perspectives, elevating your footage to new artistic heights. The AI Subject Tracking feature ensures your main subject remains perfectly framed, acting as your personal director.Enhanced Video Transmission and ConnectivityExperience stable video transmission with DJI O4 technology, supporting up to 13 km of 1080p/60fps video with excellent anti-interference capabilities. Pair with the DJI RC-N3 or RC 2 remote controller for precise control and explore vast landscapes with clarity. For complex environments, the DJI Cellular Dongle 2 maintains stable connections via a 4G network.Long-Lasting Battery and Fast ChargingThe DJI Flip's Intelligent Flight Battery offers up to 31 minutes of flight time, allowing for uninterrupted creativity. The Parallel Charging Hub enables simultaneous charging of two batteries, reducing downtime and ensuring you're always ready for the next flight.Effortless Control and EditingConnect the DJI Flip to the DJI Fly app via Wi-Fi Direct for single-handed control and easy mode switching. Voice control with "Hey Fly" commands offers hands-free operation, while the app's automatic noise reduction enhances audio quality. Quickly transfer footage at speeds up to 30MB/s and edit directly within the app to create professional-grade videos.Unlock new possibilities with the DJI Flip Drone Fly More Combo and experience the ultimate in aerial photography and videography.
